_notes.title: The name on the title card.
_notes.racerName: Your name, on the result card and beside your ghost's time difference.
_notes.theme: canyon (sandstone walls and a teal sky), ice (blue glass, a white track, a pale sun), or neon (a dark track with light strips). Each has a daytime look for light mode and an evening look for dark mode.
_notes.seed: Any word. The canyon is built from it, so the same word always gives the same canyon. Leave it out to use your name.
_notes.trackLength: short, medium, or long: about 40, 70, or 110 seconds at a good pace.
_notes.marbleColor: The color of the swirl inside the glass, as a hex color like #2f6fdb.
